sloka: लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा वैदेह्या च अपि भार्यया ।पितुः निदेश निरतो धर्मम् पन्थानम् आश्रितः ॥४-५७-८॥
transliteration: lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā vaidehyā ca api bhāryayā ।pituḥ nideśa nirato dharmam panthānam āśritaḥ ॥4-57-8॥

translations.english: The leaders among monkeys did not trust his words even though his voice was choked with grief. They suspected his intentions.
